no-image-no-list.headline: One change, and it is the one you complained about
no-image-no-list.intro: You have not signed in for a while, so this is short. There is exactly one thing worth telling you about, and it is the thing that made you stop.
no-image-no-list.highlight_text: The queue was rewritten in April. A send scheduled for 09:00 now goes at 09:00 rather than somewhere in the following twenty minutes, and the schedule page shows the real send time rather than the intended one.
no-image-no-list.action_note: Your workspace, your templates and your two API keys are all still there.
